role: 新建实际透明地图边缘组件图集，不替换旧图
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: PRODUCTION transparent PNG game map edge-component atlas for B01 Sunlit Ruins. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, eight equal cells, ideally 2048 x 1024 pixels. Real transparent RGBA alpha, no painted checkerboard.
Primary request: eight isolated complete stand-alone architectural and foliage edge modules for a bright hand-painted fantasy game. One module centered in each cell, implicit grid only, no text, labels, cell numbers, frames, background scene, floor sheet, UI, heroes or monsters. Arranged in EXACT row-major order described below.
Common art: sunny hand-painted cartoon fantasy, high three-quarter oblique near-isometric camera, realistic 2.5D thickness and soft clean outlines, warm sunlight upper-left. Clean ivory sandstone and ceramic, warm brass gold, turquoise water / glass / magic crystals, fresh sage-green vines, tiny cream flowers. Ancient classical garden with magical botanical steam technology. Cheerful, elegant and readable at small scale, not gritty or dark, no rusty winches.
Production discipline: each component has a COMPLETE silhouette and its own structurally believable support or bottom. Occupy at most 68% of cell width and 70% of cell height, generous empty transparent gutters on ALL sides, 12% bottom margin. No vine, leaf, glass, water or shadow crossing into another cell. Same camera, coherent scale and warm lighting across all eight. The modular edge objects themselves may show short honest stone side faces and a very narrow top lip, never a rectangular tile of terrain or stretched floor.
EXACT ROW ONE left to right:
1 SHORT IVY STONE RAILING, west edge module: a short low ivory garden railing with two small round end posts, airy brass leaf curls and a drape of fresh green ivy with two cream flowers. Low enough for the player to see beyond. One independent segment, no ground slab.
2 LOW STONE TERRACE SIDE, south edge module: one complete thin ivory terrace-edge strip, subtly curved, with a very narrow horizontal stone top lip and a separately painted SHORT vertical facing showing several proper small stone blocks, tiny moss at joints. Honest shallow thickness, not a tall retaining wall, no broad floor plane, no big square block.
3 OPEN NORTHERN COLONNADE, north edge module: two slender full ivory columns connected by one open brass-and-stone vine arch above, light leaves and a small cyan crystal sun hanging in the open middle. Thin open structure, not opaque wall, complete columns and feet. Small composed architectural segment.
4 OPEN ENTRANCE ARCH, gateway module: one distinct inviting classical ivory arch with slim rounded columns, brass solar crest, few ivy leaves, COMPLETE broad open doorway, no door panels, no stone wall wings, no entry ground tile.
EXACT ROW TWO left to right:
5 GLASS GREENHOUSE BACKDROP, backdrop module: one small distant-style domed transparent glass seedling greenhouse with thin brass ribs, sage-green crystal plants inside, two delicate curling copper flower branches beside it, low ivory circular foot rim. A readable single garden background silhouette, no opaque backing, no platform or broad garden ground.
6 OUTER SHALLOW CANAL, east edge module: ONE short narrow shallow turquoise water-channel segment with a white stone bank on each side, a brass tiny spout, two small lily pads, complete rounded end caps. Visibly thin and outside the playable garden, not a wide pool. Water contained only within this small component; no environment background or broad water area.
7 FOREGROUND FLOWER-LEAF SPRIG, foreground module: one airy asymmetrical arrangement of sage-green ivy leaves and three small cream/gold blossoms, lower edges naturally fade to transparent alpha and open gaps between leaves. Light soft depth, thin curved stems, no opaque dark bush blanket, no plant pot, no ground slab.
8 CORNER FLOWER RAIL, corner module: one low L-shaped ivory garden corner railing with two connected short segments, rounded brass leaf details, a soft small flowering ivy cluster on the bend, three short complete posts. Open structure, clearly usable as an outer corner, no huge solid wall and no floor tile.
Final invariants: exactly eight complete modules on a FOUR-by-TWO implicit cell grid, generous truly empty transparent gutters, true alpha background, NO labels or UI text, no opaque colored rectangle, no checkerboard art, no cropped feet, no floor texture stretched into a vertical wall, no grey empty map ring, no wide rectangular water pit. These are modular transparent ASSETS, not a scene illustration.
